title: Weekly entity counts and the change percentage definition
description:
As a reader, I want trend figures I can trust, so that "up 40%" means something stated.

```gherkin
Feature: Entity trend counting
  Scenario: Weekly series
    Given confirmed entity links with item publish dates
    When trends are computed
    Then each entity has a count per ISO week for the last 8 and 26 weeks

  Scenario: Change figure
    Given 12 items in the last 4 weeks and 6 in the prior 4
    Then the change is reported as +100 percent with counts 12 and 6

  Scenario: Small base
    Given fewer than 5 items in the prior 4 weeks
    Then no percent is reported

  Scenario: Short history
    Given an entity first linked 2 weeks ago
    Then it is marked new
```
